A commutation application to the Trump administration was reported Nov 2025; no clemency granted as of Aug 2026. She is the only person criminally convicted in connection with the Epstein network.

Dubin has consistently and explicitly denied the allegations and his spokesman stated he supplied flight records to disprove them. USVI announced a subpoena in Sept 2020 in the civil investigation; no charges resulted. He retired from Highbridge in Jan 2020.

The properties went to Karyna Shuliak and 43 pro rata beneficiaries. The record presents a superseded instrument as if operative.

'The testamentary bequest ... demonstrates a relationship far deeper than social acquaintance' - this is the record's own inference, and it is the SOLE stated basis for a Tier 1 'alleged_abuser' classification. An estate document naming a third party's daughter is not evidence that the father abused anyone.

UNPUBLISH until corrected.
reasoning: This is the textbook version of the failure mode the prior audit found: a person filed at Tier 1 as an alleged abuser on the strength of a document that contains no abuse allegation whatsoever. The entire evidence_summary is an estate-planning fact plus an inference the author drew from it. Compounding this, the estate fact itself is stated in a superseded form - Celina Dubin was removed from the operative instruments two days before Epstein died, which the record omits. Dubin is a living billionaire who has publicly and specifically denied the underlying allegation; publishing a Tier 1 'alleged_abuser' record with no cited allegation and no denial is the single clearest defamation exposure among the living non-charged subjects.

It also restates the NPA as 'blanket immunity to unnamed co-conspirators' with no district limitation, which is the framing that lets downstream records wrongly extend NPA immunity to people it never covered. Fixing this record is a prerequisite to fixing the others.
